newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian diplomat in Armenia dies climbing rope.
newsitem.headline: Russian diplomat in Armenia dies climbing rope.

text.p: A Russian diplomat died on Monday when he fell from a fourth floor while trying to climb a rope to his locked flat in an apartment block in the Armenian capital Yerevan, Interfax news agency said.

Counsellor Anatoly Rybalchenko, 52, who was hurrying to a meeting in the embassy, turned to the help of a rope after locking himself out when he went to put the rubbish, Interfax quoted the embassy officials as saying.

Rybalchenko, who worked in the former Soviet republic since 1994, lived alone in the apartment leaving his wife and two children in Moscow. Officials in Moscow was not immediately available for comment.
